title: Chlordiazepoxide against signalling, receptor and regulatory proteins of breast cancer: a structure-based in-silico approach.
authors: Alsaiari, Ahad Amer; Gharib, Amal F; Bakhuraysah, Maha Mahfouz; Alrehaili, Amani A; Algethami, Shatha M; Alsaif, Hayfa Ali; Al Harthi, Norah; Hakami, Mohammed Ageeli
one_liner_zh: 该文对乳腺癌相关蛋白进行多靶点分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: Among the most prevalent forms of cancer are breast, lung, colon-rectum, and prostate cancers, and breast cancer is a major global health challenge, contributing to 2.26 million cases with approximately 685,000 deaths worldwide in 2020 alone, typically beginning in the milk ducts or lobules that produce and transport milk during lactation and it is becoming challenging to treat as the tissues are developing resistance, which makes urgent calls for new multitargeted drugs. The multitargeted drug design provides a better solution, simultaneously targeting multiple pathways, even when the drug resists one, it remains effective for others. In this study, we included four crucial proteins that perform signalling, receptor, and regulatory action, namely- NUDIX Hydrolases, Dihydrofolate Reductase, HER2/neu Kinase and EGFR and performed multitargeted molecular docking studies against human-approved drugs using HTVS, SP and extra precise algorithms and filtered the poses with MM\GBSA, suggested a benzodiazepine derivative chlordiazepoxide, used as an anxiolytic agent, can be a multitargeted inhibitor with docking and MM\GBSA score ranging from - 4.628 to - 7.877 and - 18.59 to - 135.86 kcal/mol, respectively, and the most interacted residues were 6ARG, 6GLU, 3TRP, and 3VAL. The QikProp-based ADMET and DFT computations showed the suitability and stability of the drug candidate followed by 100 ns MD simulation in water and MMGBSA on trajectories, resulting in stable performance and many intermolecular interactions to make the complexes stable, which favours that chlordiazepoxide can be a multitargeted breast cancer inhibitor. However, experimental validation is needed before its use.
abstract_zh: 在最为常见的癌症类型中，乳腺癌、肺癌、结直肠癌和前列腺癌位居前列，其中乳腺癌是一项重大的全球健康挑战，仅在2020年就贡献了226万例病例，全球约有68.5万人死亡，该病通常始于哺乳期产生和运输乳汁的乳腺导管或小叶中，并且随着组织产生耐药性，治疗变得日益困难，这迫切呼唤新的多靶点药物。多靶点药物设计提供了更好的解决方案，可同时靶向多条通路，即使药物对某一条通路产生耐药性，对其他通路仍保持有效。在本研究中，我们纳入了四种发挥信号传导、受体和调控作用的关键蛋白，即NUDIX水解酶、二氢叶酸还原酶、HER2/neu激酶和EGFR，并利用HTVS、SP及超精确算法对已获人类批准的药物进行了多靶点分子对接研究，通过MM\GBSA对构象进行筛选，提出一种苯二氮䓬类衍生物氯氮䓬（chlordiazepoxide），用作抗焦虑剂，可作为多靶点抑制剂，其对接和MM\GBSA评分范围分别为-4.628至-7.877和-18.59至-135.86 kcal/mol，且相互作用最多的残基为6ARG、6GLU、3TRP和3VAL。基于QikProp的ADMET和DFT计算显示该药物候选物的适用性和稳定性，随后进行了100 ns的水中MD模拟及轨迹上的MMGBSA分析，结果表现出稳定的性能和许多分子间相互作用，使复合物保持稳定，这支持氯氮䓬可作为多靶点乳腺癌抑制剂。然而，在其使用前仍需实验验证。
